value.body: A copywriter writes the words in ads, campaigns, packaging, websites and promotional material. Employers include advertising and digital agencies, in-house brand teams and startups. A typical day involves reading a brief, writing headline and script options, and refining them with art directors and clients.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Any degree; B.A. English, Mass Communication or Design are common

items.label: Works with
items.value: Art directors, designers, brand and client-servicing teams

items.label: Output
items.value: Ad lines, scripts, social posts, campaign concepts

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually get in through an internship or a copy test at an agency, backed by a portfolio of spec ads or campaign ideas. Writing in more than one language is valued in many agencies.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Writing for different formats and audiences
Writing in English and an Indian language

value.title: At a glance
items: Agency work can involve tight deadlines and long hours.
Next roles: senior copywriter, associate creative director.
A portfolio usually counts for more than the degree.
